judge.notes: The front page is a true spreadsheet: a real table with th headers (Score, Title, Domain, Author, Age, Comments), thin cell grid, monospace right-leaning figures, and only the lead row highlighted in pale yellow, which matches the brief closely. Numbers are not clearly right-aligned (score and comments sit left-aligned), and the 'comments' link text glued to the count reads cramped. At 375px the table keeps Score/Title/Domain but clips Author, Age and Comments off-screen, so the required columns are lost on mobile; the thread page keeps the table header but nests comments as prose, which is reasonable.
